descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
人脸检测与五官定位能力可以检测图片中的人脸并给出每张人脸精准定位和105个关键点信息。输出人脸数量、人脸矩形坐标、人脸姿态、双瞳孔中心坐标、人脸置信度列表等信息，支持人脸遮挡、光照、模糊度、姿态、噪声综合质量评分，支持检测含有多张人脸的照片多种姿态角度判断。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 当前能力可在视觉智能开放平台有完整的免费产品体验，您可以单击[立即试用](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DetectFace)对该能力进行更直观试用以及在线购买。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 应用场景
人脸关键点检测，是后续识别、分析和特效应用的基础。它为人脸识别、表情分析、疲劳检测、三维人脸重建、人脸美颜、换脸等人脸相关应用提供了人脸精确信息。

- 互动娱乐应用：支持人脸五官及轮廓精准定位，实现动态贴纸、小视频玩法、特效相机等互动娱乐功能。
- 人脸美颜拍摄：高精度人脸关键点可进行美颜塑形，落地在图片、视频、互动直播等多种美颜场景。
- 面部定位分析：支持人脸轮廓精准定位和面部关键点分析，落地在智能医美、智能APP等高价值场景。

## 特色优势

- 高精度定位：支持眉毛、眼睛、瞳孔、鼻子、嘴等五官位置的精准定位。
- 适应能力强：不同照片、人脸尺寸多场景下，适应最大90度侧脸、平面360旋转人脸等情景。
- 支持多人脸：支持单图检测多个人脸，应对人脸编辑、换脸、姿态矫正等高精度人脸定位场景。
- 图片质量打分：支持人脸遮挡、光照、模糊度、姿态、噪声综合质量评分。
- 平台服务稳定：提供在高并发，大流量下的毫秒级识别响应和保障。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：请确保您已开通[人脸人体服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open)。
> 本能力支持企业或个人认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/DetectFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FDetectFace%2FDetectFace1.png%22%7D&tab=DEMO)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
5. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 示例代码：该能力常用语言的示例代码，请参见[人脸检测与五官定位示例代码](~~465559~~)。
7. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 输入限制

- 图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG、BMP。
- 图像大小：不超过30 MB。
- 图像分辨率：大于32×32像素，小于8192×8192像素，人脸占比不低于64×64像素。
- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

> 当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见[图片缩放](~~44688~~)。

## 计费说明
关于人脸检测与五官定位的计费方式及报价，请参见[计费介绍](~~184049~~)。
descriptions.en:
## Feature description
The face detection and facial landmark localization feature detects faces in images and provides precise localization for each face along with 105 key point coordinates. It outputs the number of faces, face bounding box coordinates, face poses, pupil center coordinates, and face confidence scores. It supports comprehensive quality scoring for face occlusion, lighting, blur, pose, and noise, and supports detection of multiple faces with various pose angles in a single image.

> - You can access [online consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) for human assistance.
- You can try this feature for free on the Visual Intelligence Open Platform. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DetectFace) to experience this feature or purchase it online.
- For questions about API integration and usage of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join the DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common scenarios
Facial landmark detection is the foundation for subsequent recognition, analysis, and special effects applications. It provides precise face information for face recognition, expression analysis, fatigue detection, 3D face reconstruction, face beautification, face swapping, and other face-related applications.

- Interactive entertainment: Supports precise localization of facial features and contours to enable dynamic stickers, short video effects, special effect cameras, and other interactive entertainment features.
- Face beautification: High-precision facial landmarks enable beautification and reshaping, applicable to image, video, and interactive live streaming scenarios.
- Facial localization and analysis: Supports precise face contour localization and facial landmark analysis for high-value scenarios such as smart medical aesthetics and intelligent applications.

## Key advantages

- High-precision localization: Supports precise localization of facial features including eyebrows, eyes, pupils, nose, and mouth.
- Strong adaptability: Adapts to various scenarios with different images and face sizes, including side faces up to 90 degrees and 360-degree in-plane rotation.
- Multi-face support: Supports detecting multiple faces in a single image for high-precision face localization scenarios such as face editing, face swapping, and pose correction.
- Image quality scoring: Supports comprehensive quality scoring for face occlusion, lighting, blur, pose, and noise.
- Stable platform service: Provides millisecond-level recognition response and reliability under high concurrency and heavy traffic.

## Access guide
1. Register an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Register Now** in the upper-right corner, and follow the instructions to complete account registration.
2. Activate the service: Make sure you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).
> This feature is available for enterprise or individual verified users. For more information about real-name verification, see [Real-name verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
3. Create an AccessKey: Make sure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you use a RAM user AccessKey, grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/DetectFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FDetectFace%2FDetectFace1.png%22%7D&tab=DEMO) for online debugging, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
5. Development steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use in [SDK overview](~~145033~~).
- Find the SDK package for the Face and Body (facebody) AI category in the corresponding language SDK documentation and install it.
- Modify the sample code provided in the documentation as needed and make the call.

6. Sample code: For sample code in commonly used languages, see [Face Detection and Facial Landmark Localization sample code](~~465559~~).
7. Client-side direct calls: The commonly used client-side calling methods for this feature include the following.
- [Direct call from web frontend](~~467779~~)
- [Direct call from mini programs](~~467780~~)
- [Direct call from Android](~~467781~~)
- [Direct call from iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input limits

- Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG, or BMP.
- Image size: up to 30 MB.
- Image resolution: greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 8192 × 8192 pixels. The face must occupy at least 64 × 64 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see [Image Resizing](~~44688~~).

## Billing
For information about the billing methods and pricing of face detection and facial landmark localization, see [Billing overview](~~184049~~).
